notes.title: Major Update (Apr 2022)
notes.content:
We present to your attention a global update. A continuation of the storyline was implemented, namely 1 location - a medical center. You have to pass a series of fun tests on the ability of "android". However, we will not disclose all the details, hurry up to buy the game before it goes up in price.
